headings.text: How to Build English Vocabulary Fast (Without Cramming)

paragraphs: Forget long word lists. Learn words in context, use spaced repetition, and speak them the same day.
Cramming 100 words fails. Context and use win. Here is a fast system.
Do not learn "ubiquitous = everywhere". Learn: "Phones are ubiquitous today." The sentence carries meaning.
Say the new word in a real sentence before sleeping. Speaking locks it in.
Review after 1 day, 3 days, 7 days. Apps like Anki do this. Or use a simple notebook.
One week: office words. Next: food. Grouping helps the brain file them.
Read short English articles. Guess meaning from context before checking.
The app gives a word, you use it in a sentence aloud. Wrong use is corrected instantly.
10 new words a day = 300 a month. That is a strong working vocabulary in a year.
Free browser-based English speaking practice. No downloads, no sign-ups, no data leaving your computer.
